name: foodbridge-ai
description: FoodBridge AI — Predict. Match. Redistribute. Root orchestration for the backend, AI service, frontend and database.

scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,ai,web --prefix-colors green,magenta,cyan "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:ai" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:ai && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint && node deployment/scripts/run-ai.mjs --ruff
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
